Th ousands of Eyes Th e swarm has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Cloud of Birds Th e swarm occupies a 30 ft. radius (Gargantuan) 
space and can move through any opening large enough for a 
Tiny creature. 
Undulating Murmuration Th e swarm of birds moves in dizzying 
patterns. Ranged attack rolls outside of 60 ft. are made with 
Disadvantage against it.
Trilling Death Creatures have the Deafened condition while 
within the swarm's space. In addition, any creature within 60 ft. 
must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Th row on each of 
their turns to maintain their Concentration.
Frenzied Th e swarm has Advantage on attack rolls against 
Bloodied creatures.
Actions
Legendary Actions
Legendary Action Uses 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another 
creature's turn, the maedrynn murmuration can expend a Legendary 
Action Use to take one of the following actions. Th e swarm regains all 
expended Legendary Actions at the start of each of its turns.
Disperse Th e swarm spreads out in a tall column, leaving more 
space between each individual bird. Th e swarm gains +1 bonus 
to its Armor Class (total AC 22) and loses its Vulnerability to 
Th under damage, until the beginning of its turn.
Screeching Cacophony Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, all 
creatures within the swarm's space. Failure: 16 (3d10) Th under 
damage. Success: Half damage.
Pulling Beaks Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 16, one target in the 
swarm’s space. Failure: Target has the Restrained condition 
(Escape DC 14) as birds pluck and pull at their limbs.
Challenge 24 (XP 62,000; PB 7)
Skills Acrobatics +15, Perception +10,
Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing
Grave Temptations Emboldened by the multitude of bones, 
scavengers try their luck on the outskirts, 6 miles from the 
Lair. Double the amount of creatures from the results on the 
Scavengers Table.
Lingering Hunger Sated individual maedrynn hummingbirds 
busying themselves with preparing their nests within 5 miles of 
the Lair may still single out nearby creatures for a bite of flesh. 
Increased likelihood to target Maedrynn Young (pg. 98).
Dreadful Flight Flying creatures within 4 miles of the Lair are 
overcome with fear from the cloud of birds on the horizon.
Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12, any creature with a flying speed 
attempting to move. Failure: Target creature lowers their flying 
speed to a minimum of 10 ft., the target repeats the save at the 
end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 
After 5 minutes, it succeeds automatically and doesn't need to 
take this test again for 1 day.
Barren Plains Little is left of the many creatures that roamed 
these fi elds but bloody bones. Travelers within 3 miles of the 
Lair must re-roll the fi rst of any creature results for Hunting 
Expeditions.
Ceaseless Trilling Th e massive murmuration of hummingbirds 
shriek and call constantly and from within 2 miles of the Lair. 
Creatures that attempt a Long Rest must succeed on a DC 15 
Constitution Saving Th row or gain one level of Exhaustion from 
the fi tful rest. Additionally, creatures have Disadvantage on 
Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
Watchful Cloud Within 1 mile, the frenzied eyes of thousands 
of maedrynn above look hungrily for the movement of any prey. 
Creatures out in the open, 1 mile of the Lair must make a DC 14 
Dexterity (Stealth) check to not alert the maedrynn murmuration 
of their presence for every hour they remain outside.
Fade and Form Th e maedrynn murmuration swarm breaks 
apart into thousands of individual birds and reforms into a free 
space within 60 ft. of itself. 
Darting Death Dealers Th e maedrynn murmuration swarm 
designates a point within 60 ft. of itself. Dexterity Saving Th row:
DC 18, all creatures within 5 ft. of the selected point. Failure: 17 
(5d6) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage. 
Cloud of Fear Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 17, all creatures within 60 
ft. that can see or hear the swarm. Failure: Target creature has 
the Frightened condition until the maedrynn murmuration 
swarm's next turn.
Buffeting Wings Th e maedrynn murmuration swarm selects a 
target creature within 60 ft. of itself. Strength Saving Th row: DC 
14, target creature. Failure: Th e creature is pushed 10 ft. in the 
direction of the swarm's choice.
Distracted Feast Th e maedrynn murmuration swarm designates 
a point within 60 ft. of itself that hosts the remains of one of 
their earlier meals. Until the maedrynn murmuration swarm's 
next turn, 20 ft. from that point is Obscured, as the birds thickly 
flock and feast.
[Seasonal] Calling Cries Th e cries of hunger gather more 
maedrynn to join the murmur. Th e maedrynn murmuration 
swarm gains 5 (1d10) Health Points (HP) as more birds join the 
swarm.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the maedrynn 
murmuration takes a lair action to cause one of the following 
effects, the swarm can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row.
Lair Actions
Regional Effects
A dark storm of feathers spreads across the sky in dizzying 
patterns, beneath it for miles lay the bones of creatures too slow 
to escape this seasonal frenzy.

Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When Bloodied and in melee combat.
On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 18, the swarm. Success:
Individual maedrynn flock to join the swarm, the maedrynn 
murmuration swarm immediately gains 10 (1d20) Health Points 
(HP).
Multiattack Th e swarm makes three attacks, using Serrated 
Beaks, Hungering Outliers, or Feasting Stormin in any 
combination.
Serrated Beaks Melee Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 0 ft., one 
target in the swarm’s space. Hit: 36 (8d6+8) Slashing damage, or 
22 (4d6+8) Slashing damage if the swarm is Bloodied. Dexterity 
Saving Th row: DC 8, one creature that the swarm successfully hit 
with its Serrated Beaks attack. Failure: Th e target has the Blind 
condition until the swarms next turn, as the birds slash at their 
eyes.
Hungering Outliers Ranged Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 60 
ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6+8) Slashing damage, or 18 (3d6+8) 
Slashing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.
Feasting Storm Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 18, all creatures within 
the swarm's space. Failure: 38 (12d4+8) Slashing damage and the 
creature has the Prone condition, or 23 (6d4+8) Slashing damage 
if the swarm is Bloodied. Success: Half damage.
